# MakeMyTrip Cosmos Design Tokens

> The single source of truth for the Cosmos design system: 542 design tokens
> authored in Tokens Studio format and compiled to CSS, TypeScript, SwiftUI and
> Jetpack Compose. Two tiers — primitives hold raw values, semantic tokens hold
> role-based intent. Product code uses the semantic tier only.

Start with dist/tokens.json. It is the complete machine-readable manifest: every
token with its resolved value, tier, status, description, contrast verdict,
paired foreground, state variants, and its name on each of the four platforms.
Reading it is faster and safer than parsing any generated platform file.

Cosmos ships a single light theme. There is no dark mode, no elevation or shadow
scale, no opacity, z-index or breakpoint tokens. Do not invent them.

One trap worth stating up front: the `warning` intent resolves to **red**, not
amber. It is deprecated in favour of `danger`. Amber advisory is `caution`.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the rules for writing product code against Cosmos — which tier to use, how to find a contrast-safe foreground, what is deliberately missing.
- [docs/recipes.md](docs/recipes.md): the exact token for every part of a button, input, card, badge, banner, modal, list row, tab, tooltip, toggle and empty state.
- [docs/naming.md](docs/naming.md): the naming grammar. Names are generated by ordered slots with closed vocabularies, so a name can be derived from intent rather than recalled.
- [README.md](README.md): pipeline architecture, build internals, design decisions and the full token inventory.

## Source

- [tokens/tokens.json](tokens/tokens.json): the only hand-edited file. Everything in dist/ is generated.
- [tokens/tokens.schema.json](tokens/tokens.schema.json): JSON Schema for the source structure.
- [build-tokens.mjs](build-tokens.mjs): Style Dictionary pipeline and the custom platform transforms.
- [scripts/lint-tokens.mjs](scripts/lint-tokens.mjs): the invariants the build enforces — naming grammar, foreground pairing, contrast minimums, aliasing, metadata.
- [scripts/token-lint-baseline.json](scripts/token-lint-baseline.json): known accepted debt, each entry with a written reason.

## Optional

- [dist/web/tokens.css](dist/web/tokens.css): CSS custom properties.
- [dist/web/tokens.ts](dist/web/tokens.ts): ESM export.
- [dist/ios/CosmosTokens.swift](dist/ios/CosmosTokens.swift): SwiftUI enum.
- [dist/android/CosmosTokens.kt](dist/android/CosmosTokens.kt): Compose object.
